flag_definitions.LOW_RESOLUTION: minimum side strictly below 512, the Phase 23 reference 5th percentile
flag_definitions.BLURRY: Laplacian variance strictly below the Phase 23 5th percentile
flag_definitions.TOO_DARK: mean luminance strictly below the Phase 23 5th percentile
flag_definitions.TOO_BRIGHT: mean luminance strictly above the Phase 23 95th percentile
flag_definitions.LOW_CONTRAST: luminance standard deviation strictly below the Phase 23 5th percentile
flag_definitions.EXTREME_ASPECT_RATIO: width/height strictly outside the Phase 23 5th to 95th percentile
flag_definitions.EXCESSIVE_CLIPPING: near-black or near-white fraction strictly above its Phase 23 95th percentile
flag_definitions.SUSPICIOUS_FRAMING: foreground-occupancy proxy strictly below the Phase 23 5th percentile

level_definitions.1: One or two flags, excluding low resolution, and not both too-dark and low-contrast.
level_definitions.2: LOW_RESOLUTION, or LOW_CONTRAST together with TOO_DARK, or three or more flags, or minimum side below 512.
